description: November 29 birthday meaning: Sagittarius decan 1, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 29 birthday falls in Sagittarius, in the first decan, with Jupiter as the sign's ruler and Jupiter as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Sagittarius is mutable and fire.

sections.heading: Personality of a November 29 birthday
paragraphs: Inspiration is the keyword for November 29. Its birthday number is the master number 11, kept whole and associated with intuition and vision, while the Sun at seven degrees of Sagittarius sits in Jupiter's decan, linked with faith and meaning. Together they suggest an enthusiastic idealist who can spark belief in others, sometimes before they fully believe it themselves.

By noon UTC on November 29, the Sun has normally reached roughly 7° of Sagittarius. That places the date in the Sagittarius decan that astrologers give to Jupiter, the first of three. Jupiter rules Sagittarius and presides over its first decan as well, from about November 23 to December 1. This is traditionally the most expansive, optimistic stretch of the sign. Natives are often described as adventurous, generous and philosophical, eager to travel, learn and share whatever they have discovered. Humour and candour come easily, and so can a tendency to say the true thing a little too bluntly. Doubled Jupiter can make commitments multiply faster than time allows. These Archers tend to thrive when their search for meaning has room to roam but also somewhere to come home to.

sections.heading: Numerology of the November 29 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 29th, your compound is 2 + 9 = 11, and because 11 is a master number it is kept as 11 rather than reduced to 2. The 2 brings sensitivity, the 9 brings compassion and breadth, and together they create one of the most intuitive birthday numbers. People born on the 29th are often described as emotionally perceptive, idealistic and capable of inspiring others. Their feelings can run high, with marked highs and lows. As a secondary number, the 29 tends to reward creative and caring outlets for that intensity, and rest between them.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same November 29 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 4 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 33. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: November 29 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 29 is the 333rd day of the year (334th in a leap year). In most years Capricorn season is under way by December 22, 23 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a November 29 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. November 29 is also the birthday of C. S. Lewis (1898), Louisa May Alcott (1832) and Empress Dowager Cixi (1835).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 29?
faq.answer: November 29 is Sagittarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Sagittarius, which tradition links with Jupiter.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 29?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 29 the Life Path is 11 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 4 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 29th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 29?
faq.answer: By November 29 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 29?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a November 29 birthday are C. S. Lewis (1898), Louisa May Alcott (1832) and Empress Dowager Cixi (1835). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
